method: Original CPU schedulers execute; exact device-wrapper and build-geometry calls are recorded at stated services. Compare full inline memory, unchanged external globals, ordered arguments, resets and allocation words. Geometry service applies explicit fixture counter changes; no actual GPU calls.
limits: Device/cache services are recording boundaries and do not mutate tracked CPU state. Flush geometry service may change only vertex/group/generated counters.
Direct draw counts are bounded: vertexCount divisible by4 and at most14000, groupCount at most250; edge/start words retain full32-bit wrap semantics.
Draw scheduler uses immediate inline globals rather than allocated pointer contents. Preserve that original behavior; no assertion that this legacy GPU path is active or functional.
Allocate cursor is disjoint from global pointer slots; full32-bit cursor wrap allowed, allocation backing not dereferenced.
No managed or live graphics execution.
